meta: Concept site for Coolwash Air Co., a made-up Mesa, Arizona AC and heating company: same-day AC repair, new systems, heat pumps and tune-ups. Designed by shash.builds.

hero.title: Cold air back on, before the afternoon peak.
hero.sub: AC repair, new systems and tune-ups across the East Valley. Call before 2pm and we aim to be at your door the same day.
facts: Upfront price before any work starts

extra.title: What an AC company in Mesa should promise.
items: When you call before 2pm on a weekday.
We'll check any replacement quote you got elsewhere, free.
Spring for cooling, fall for heating, with a written report.

services_title: Everything that keeps the house at 72.
services: Warm air, no air, ice on the lines or strange noises. Fixed fast, priced before we start.
Right-sized systems with a load calculation, not a guess from the square footage.
Install and repair for the units that heat and cool from one box.
Coil cleaning, refrigerant check and a written report, twice a year.
Sealing, repairs and balancing for rooms that never cool down.
Smart thermostats, filters and air purifiers, installed and set up.
steps_title: From warm house to cold air.
steps: Tell us what the system is doing. We give you a time window, not an all-day wait.
The tech finds the problem and shows you the price before any work starts.
Most repairs are done on the first visit. We call the next day to make sure it's holding.

g1.alt: A row of outdoor AC condenser units and ducting along a back wall.

g2.alt: Dry desert scrub and Joshua trees under a pale blue sky with mountains behind.

area.title: Mesa and the East Valley.
area.note: Our trucks are spread across the East Valley in summer so the drive to you stays short.

about.title: Local techs who know desert heat.
body: An AC in Mesa works harder than almost anywhere in the country. Systems that last fifteen years elsewhere can wear out in ten here.
Our techs only work in the East Valley. They know which units struggle at 115, which attics trap heat, and when a repair is still worth it.

promise.title: If the same part fails within a year, the fix is on us.
promise.body: Parts and labor on every repair are covered for 12 months, in writing. No fine print about service fees.

faq: How fast can you come out?
Call before 2pm on a weekday and we aim to be there the same day. In peak summer we give you a two-hour window.
Should I repair or replace my AC?
If the system is under ten years old and the repair is less than a third of a new one, repair usually wins. We'll show you both numbers.
Coil cleaning, refrigerant and electrical checks, drain line flush, filter change and a written report with photos.
Do you work on heat pumps?
Yes, repairs and new installs for all major brands.
Is there a fee to come out?
There's a flat diagnostic fee, and it's waived if you go ahead with the repair.

form.title: Tell us what the system is doing.
form.note: We call back within 30 minutes during business hours to set a time.
